Profile Diacerein is an anthraquinone derivative that is used in osteoar- thritis (p.11) in oral doses of 50 mg twice daily. Doses should be halved in patients with creatinine clearance less than 30 mL/minute. Diarrhoea is a common adverse effect with diac- erein.
